pages.text: $(li)$(l)trigger block$(): starts a process when it gets a redstone pulse.$(li)$(l)timer block$(): starts a process again and again, at an interval you set.$(li)$(l)debug trigger block$(): starts a process when you hit it with the debugging tool.

Trigger blocks work in every dimension. In the c0de dimension, you can only place them on the black floor outside the sheets.$(br2)A redstone signal pauses a timer block. Use a lever to switch it off.
